layout.hierarchy: Title is the largest and boldest element (two-color). The network diagram dominates by area on the right. The red equation block is the secondary focal point upper-left. The tan 'Multi-Class Classification' box is a small tertiary label. Black bar and red rule are decorative framing with lowest visual weight.

visual_elements.description: Rectangle with thin red border and cream fill containing three left-aligned equations, one per line: 'd₁(X) = W₁ᵀ X = w₁₁x₁+w₁₂x₂+....+w₁ₙxₙ+b₁*1', 'd₂(X) = W₂ᵀ X = w₂₁x₁+w₂₂x₂+....+w₂ₙxₙ+b₂*1', 'dₘ(X) = Wₘᵀ X = wₘ₁x₁+wₘ₂x₂+....+wₘₙxₙ+bₘ*1'. Each W carries an underline beneath it and its subscript; the trailing term is bias b times the constant input 1 ('*1').
Small tan/beige rectangle containing the centered two-line text 'Multi-Class Classification' in bold italic dark red.

Fully-connected single-layer perceptron for multi-class classification, enclosed in a white rectangle with a thin blue border. LEFT: vertical input column labeled top-to-bottom x₁, x₂, x₃, '...', '...', xₙ, 1 (the '1' is the bias input; two ellipsis rows indicate omitted inputs). CENTER-RIGHT: three summation neurons drawn as circles with light-cyan fill, teal ring, each containing 'Σ' — top Σ (~y 33%), middle Σ (~y 57%), bottom Σ (~y 80%). CONNECTIONS: thin straight lines fan from every input to every Σ, color-coded per output neuron — red bundle to top Σ, blue bundle to middle Σ, green bundle to bottom Σ. Weight labels placed along the lines: red w₁₁, w₁₂, w₁₃, w₁ₙ and red b₁ (b₁ sits just above the bias input '1'); blue w₂₁, w₂₂, w₂₃, w₂ₙ and blue b₂; green wₘ₁, wₘ₂, wₘ₃, wₘₙ and green bₘ. Between middle and bottom Σ, three small hollow circles stacked vertically act as a vertical ellipsis for omitted neurons. Each Σ emits a short red arrow right into a small activation box: white/pink-filled rectangle with magenta border containing a blue step/threshold-function glyph (vertical bar with horizontal strokes). From each activation box a red arrow points to a two-line black bold output: top '>0 Class I' / '<0 Not Class I'; middle '>0 Class II' / '<0 Not Class II'; bottom '>0 Class m' / '<0 Not Class m' (each second line wraps, e.g. '<0 Not Class' + 'I').
Solid black horizontal strip across the bottom of the slide (footer band, no text).
Thin dark-red vertical rule near the left edge, running from just below the top edge to the bottom black bar.

imagery: No photographs or illustrations. Icon-style vector glyphs only: three light-cyan 'Σ' summation circles with teal rings inside the diagram, and three small pink-bordered boxes each containing a blue step/threshold activation-function glyph (vertical bar with horizontal strokes).
typography_notes: Title: large bold sans-serif (Arial/Verdana-like), ~36-40pt, two-color (red with the single word 'Layer' in blue). Equations: italic serif/math-style font, red, with bold-italic d and X, underlined W with subscripts, and subscripted w and b terms. 'Multi-Class Classification': bold italic sans-serif, dark red, centered on two lines. Diagram labels: small sans-serif; weight labels italic; output decision texts bold black sans-serif. No all-caps styling; no numbered bullets anywhere on the slide.
animation_state: Slide appears fully built and static; all three equations, all diagram elements and all three output labels are visible simultaneously. No mid-build state detected.
recreation_brief: 1) Set slide background to white (#FFFFFF). Add a thin dark-red (#C00000) vertical line ~6% from the left edge spanning nearly full height, and a solid black (#000000) rectangle strip across the bottom (~5% of slide height). 2) Insert a centered title text box at the top: 'Visualization of Single Layer Perceptron', bold sans-serif ~36pt; color 'Visualization of Single ' and 'Perceptron' in #C00000 and the word 'Layer' in #0000CC. 3) Upper-left: draw a rectangle ~41% wide with fill #FFFFCC and red (#C00000) border; inside, left-align three lines of red italic serif text with underlined W and subscripts: 'd₁(X) = W₁ᵀ X = w₁₁x₁+w₁₂x₂+....+w₁ₙxₙ+b₁*1', 'd₂(X) = W₂ᵀ X = w₂₁x₁+w₂₂x₂+....+w₂ₙxₙ+b₂*1', 'dₘ(X) = Wₘᵀ X = wₘ₁x₁+wₘ₂x₂+....+wₘₙxₙ+bₘ*1'. 4) Middle-left: draw a small tan (#D9D9A6) rectangle with centered bold-italic dark-red (#8B0000) text on two lines: 'Multi-Class Classification'. 5) Right side: draw a large white rectangle with a thin blue (#0000FF) border (~49% wide, ~64% tall). 6) Inside it, stack input labels on the left: x₁, x₂, x₃, '...', '...', xₙ, 1 (small black sans-serif). 7) Place three circles filled #CCFFFF with teal (#339999) rings, each containing 'Σ', at top-right, middle-right and bottom-right of the panel. 8) Draw thin connector lines from every input to every Σ: red (#FF0000) lines to the top Σ, blue (#0000FF) to the middle Σ, green (#008000) to the bottom Σ. 9) Label the lines with color-matched italic weight labels: red w₁₁, w₁₂, w₁₃, w₁ₙ and b₁ (b₁ just above the '1' input); blue w₂₁, w₂₂, w₂₃, w₂ₙ and b₂; green wₘ₁, wₘ₂, wₘ₃, wₘₙ and bₘ. 10) Between the middle and bottom Σ, add three small hollow circles stacked vertically as an ellipsis. 11) From each Σ draw a short red arrow right into a small rectangle with pink/magenta (#FF99CC) border containing a blue (#0000CC) step-function glyph (vertical bar with two horizontal strokes). 12) From each activation box draw a red arrow to bold black two-line text: top '>0 Class I' / '<0 Not Class I'; middle '>0 Class II' / '<0 Not Class II'; bottom '>0 Class m' / '<0 Not Class m' (let the second line wrap naturally). 13) Verify no slide number or footer text is added beyond the black bar.
